subject: Upfront credit structure for 2yr prepay — proposal / approval
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@greenfield.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Rahul Mehta <rahul@greenfield.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T16:12:00-04:00
Subject: Upfront credit structure for 2yr prepay — proposal

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Greenfield asked me to follow up with an ask: we are evaluating a 2-year committed prepay and want to understand Redwood's flexibility on an upfront-credit / schedule that smooths recognition over time. Key points from our side:

- Target commitment: $1.2M USD (2-year term)
- We prefer to pay Year 1 + Year 2 upfront (single invoice) in exchange for a term discount
- Want a ramp schedule so monthly burn in year 1 effectively looks like 65% of full rate, moving to 100% end of year 1 into year 2
- Need to get procurement and revenue recognition language for internal finance review (PO + contract)

Attached is our worksheet with preferred schedule (Greenfield_PREPAY_request.xlsx). Can Redwood provide: a) a commercial proposal with the effective discount for 2-year upfront, b) a suggested ramp schedule, and c) any early-termination or refund language? We are on a tight timeline — aiming to sign by Oct 15.

Appreciate any examples of how you’ve handled upfront credits for other customers.

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Head of Procurement
Greenfield AI

[attachment: Greenfield_PREPAY_request.xlsx]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T18:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Upfront credit structure for 2yr prepay — proposal

Hi Amit —

Thanks for the clear worksheet and timeline. I’ve reviewed the attachment and sketched an initial commercial approach below. Looping in Marcus (Sales Dir) and Laura (Revenue/Legal) to confirm feasibility and any governance limits.

Proposed commercial starting point (internal draft):
- Commitment: $1.2M USD, paid upfront at signature
- Term: 24 months
- Effective term discount offered: 18% off list across the commitment when paid upfront in full
- Ramp schedule: Redwood would apply an upfront credit that makes monthlyized consumption translate to:
  * Months 1–6: 65% effective rate of full list
  * Months 7–12: 85% effective rate
  * Months 13–24: 100% effective rate
- Refunds/ETC: pro-rata refund on unused balance less a 10% termination fee unless termination is for documented material breach

Open questions for internal review:
- Is 18% within discount authority for a 2-year prepay at this ACV?
- Finance: can revenue be recognized per consumption schedule or do we need to front-load?
- Legal: suggested redlines to the refund/termination clause above

Marcus/Laura — any redlines on discount %, refund terms, or billing recognition that would block this being shared as an offered term to Greenfield? I can hold off externally until we confirm.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@greenfield.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upfront credit structure for 2yr prepay — proposal

All —

Happy to align behind Soojin’s proposal with one adjustment. Context: Greenfield is strategic (platform-wide inference) and this ACV is in a band where we can be aggressive on term discounts to win multi-year commitments. I would propose final external-facing terms: 

- Offer headline discount: 20% off list for 2-year full upfront (to be presented as a limited window incentive)
- Internal floor for approval: 16% — requires Laura/Finance sign-off to move above 16%
- Maintain the ramp schedule Soojin suggested, but convert the termination fee to 7.5% if they prepay in full (softer language helps close)

I'd like Laura and Aditya to confirm finance recognition and the approved discount range. If legal is comfortable, I'll present 20% to Amit as a limited-time offer and mark the deal in HubSpot (GF-2026-78921). Attaching my pricing sheet with modeled unit economics.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[attachment: Redwood_2yr_pricing_sheet.xlsx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Finance Ops <finance.ops@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upfront credit structure for 2yr prepay — proposal

Marcus / Soojin —

Thanks for the context. Finance and Legal have reviewed. Summary of approved limits and required contract language: 

- Commercial: Approved discount range 16%–18% as the standard approval band for a $1.2M upfront prepay. 20% would need VP Sales sign-off + CFO. 
- We will approve 18% as an exception on a binding offer if Sales secures final sign-off from their leadership and the customer signs within the Oct 15 window. Please document the approval chain in HubSpot before sending the 18% offer.
- Termination/refund: Approve pro-rata refund less a 7.5% administrative fee (replaces Marcus’s 10%). Legal will require the refund to be calculated on remaining unconsumed dollars on a daily pro-rata basis.
- Revenue recognition: Finance requires the contract to state consumption-based recognition and Redwood’s right to invoice the full upfront amount. We'll need to include the consumption schedule as an exhibit. Aditya, can you confirm the exhibit template to attach to the order form?

Action items:
- Marcus/Soojin: If you want to present 18% to the customer, add a HubSpot note that includes my approval and route the final term sheet to revenueops@redwood.com.
- Soojin: prepare the PO template and DocuSign packet — include the exhibit for monthly consumption schedule.

I’m copying Finance Ops and Aditya for the revenue recognition exhibit and to prep the invoice flow.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations & Legal
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Final offer: 2-year upfront prepay terms (Greenfield AI)

Hi Amit —

Great to align. Redwood can offer Greenfield the following binding commercial terms if you can confirm by Oct 15: 

Summary of final offer (approved):
- Commitment: $1.2M USD, paid upfront at signature
- Term: 24 months (effective from purchase order date)
- Headline discount: 18% off list (exception approved by Revenue)
- Ramp / consumption exhibit (attached):
  * Months 1–6: 65% of list (credit applied via upfront balance)
  * Months 7–12: 85% of list
  * Months 13–24: 100% of list
- Termination/refund: pro-rata refund of unused balance with a 7.5% administrative fee; refund calculated daily on remaining unconsumed dollars
- Billing: Redwood will invoice the full upfront amount at signature. Consumption-based recognition will be captured in the attached exhibit.

Attached: PO template, consumption exhibit, and the pricing sheet we modeled (PO_template_Greenfield.docx, Redwood_2yr_pricing_sheet.xlsx). I’ve also created the DocuSign packet to accelerate execution: https://docuSign.com/link/abcdef123456.

Next steps:
1) Confirm acceptance of the 18% headline discount by Oct 15.
2) Procurement to return signed PO + countersign via DocuSign.
3) Finance will issue invoice and we will provision dedicated capacity per the consumption exhibit.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-minute call if you want to walk through the schedule.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
